name: Using Git Worktrees
description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace or before executing implementation plans — ensures an isolated workspace via git worktree.

commands.description: Isolate feature work with git worktrees
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the using-git-worktrees skill: create a git worktree for the feature branch so work is isolated from the main workspace; run setup in the worktree and clean up when done.
